cands.name: Jody Linton

top: The Political Action Committee Of The Business Council Of Alabama
money.note: Covers January 2023 on, primary and general. Party-committee lines are often in-kind staff and mail.
money.source: Alabama Fair Campaign Practices Act system, downloaded Nov 5, 2026

cands.bio: Republican elected to Alabama House District 91 in 2026. Works in business development at the accounting firm Carr, Riggs & Ingram, where his campaign says he has been for more than 13 years. Graduate of Samson High School and Troy University. Has held no prior elected office.
cands.gaps: We found no statements or actions from Jody Linton on data centers, growth and development, land ownership by investors or foreign buyers, immigration or H-1B, policing, guns, or school choice and teacher pay. His campaign pledges to lower taxes and cut state spending, but he has not said anything specific about homestead property taxes. We could not find his birthplace, where he grew up, or when he moved to Alabama. We could not verify his claim of owning a small business for 25+ years, or the name of any business he owns. We found no news coverage, controversies, endorsements or foreign ties.

qual.background: Has worked in business development at the accounting firm Carr, Riggs & Ingram for more than 13 years. qual.why: Business experience and a career advising businesses on finances put him in the middle band. He has no legislative, law or public budget background.
